article.title: Agoda把AI旅遊助手擴至21個市場，串連規劃與預訂
article.title_en: Agoda expands its AI travel assistant to 21 markets
article.summary: Agoda於10月30日公布，手機AI助手由9月有限測試擴至21個市場，結合對話規劃與即時可訂庫存。
article.summary_en: Agoda’s October 30 announcement expands its mobile assistant from a September test to 21 markets, linking trip planning with live bookable inventory.
article.why: 酒店需同時維護房價、庫存及地點資料，連接對話探索與實際預訂。

highlights_en: A trip canvas retains preferences, bookings and unfinished plans.
OpenAI powers conversation; Gemini with Google Maps Grounding supports restaurant and attraction information.
article.detail:
Agoda於10月30日公布，手機AI助手由9月有限測試擴至21個市場，結合對話規劃與即時可訂庫存。

行程畫布保留偏好、預訂及待定計劃。

對話採用OpenAI模型；餐廳與景點資訊結合Gemini及Google Maps Grounding。

酒店需同時維護房價、庫存及地點資料，連接對話探索與實際預訂。

檢查主要房型、取消政策及地圖資料，再驗收一條指定日期的預訂路徑。

公告未列出全部市場與帳戶資格；未披露轉換率，不能推論預訂增長或香港全面開放。
article.detail_en:
Agoda’s October 30 announcement expands its mobile assistant from a September test to 21 markets, linking trip planning with live bookable inventory.

A trip canvas retains preferences, bookings and unfinished plans.

OpenAI powers conversation; Gemini with Google Maps Grounding supports restaurant and attraction information.

Hotels should keep rates, availability and location information consistent across conversational discovery and booking.

Reconcile room types, cancellation terms and map listings, then check one dated booking journey.

The release does not enumerate all eligible markets or accounts or disclose conversion rates; booking gains and universal Hong Kong access are unproven.
